column1:
[BEFORE] Who we're talking to
Main: women 28–45 with office, design or tech jobs who live near the studio (Chacarita, Colegiales, Villa Crespo, Palermo). They're tired of screens and want something calm to do with their hands, often with a friend.
Second: English-speaking expats and digital nomads who live in BA for months (good fit for Wednesday).
Not for classes: tourists. They're leaving soon, so sell them mugs and nothing more.
column2:
[DURING] Get their contact (the big leak today)
• Swap "follow me on Instagram" for a QR code that opens WhatsApp with a ready-made message: "Hola Lucía, quiero info de las clases". Put it on the stall sign and on a small card inside every mug bag.
• Switch to WhatsApp Business (free, same app). Turn on the auto-reply with prices and the next taster date, and use labels: Interesado · Taster · Alumna · Ex-alumna.
• Note every lead in one Google Sheet (name, where they came from, date, status).
column3:
[AFTER] A first month they'll love
• Before class 1, send a WhatsApp welcome: what to wear, the address, "you'll take home a piece you made".
• Make sure every new student has a piece out of the kiln by week 4. Seeing the finished piece is what makes people come back.
• In week 3, send a personal message: "How's it going? Want to keep your seat next month?" Don't wait for them to ask.

column1:
[BEFORE] What we say
"Three hours with your hands in clay and your phone in a drawer. Small group, 6 people max, 10 min from Lacroze."
• Always show hands on the wheel. Your Reels already get 5–10x more views.
• Write captions in Spanish + a short English line: "Classes in English welcome."
• Always end with one next step: "Book the taster → link in bio."
column2:
[DURING] Keep in touch until they're ready
• One message a month to your WhatsApp broadcast list: next taster date, seats left, and one nice photo. That's all. (Note: broadcasts only reach people who saved your number, so ask them to: "guardame para enterarte de fechas".)
• Post 2 Reels/week. Film both in one session and post them later.
• Change the Linktree from a PDF to three plain buttons: Taster · Monthly class · WhatsApp.
column3:
[AFTER] Stop the "my schedule changed" drop-off
• Once Wednesday exists, let students switch between Saturday and Wednesday and give 1 make-up class a month. A schedule change stops being a reason to quit.
• 3-month pass: pay 3 months up front for ARS 330,000 (saves 30,000).
• Students get 15% off mugs, because they already buy them as gifts.
• In March, hold a small student show + mate afternoon. It gives people a goal to stay for.

column1:
[BEFORE] Where we say it
• Sunday fair: you're already there and already get asked. Now capture the contact (see DURING).
• Instagram Reels: 2/week. Each month, put ARS 35,000 into boosting the best Reel to women 25–45 within ~4 km of the studio.
• Google Maps listing (free): so people searching "clases de cerámica Chacarita" or "pottery class Buenos Aires" can find you. Add photos and ask students for reviews.
• Expat groups (BA expat Facebook/WhatsApp groups): one post a month about the Wednesday group, in English.
column2:
[DURING] Turn the yes into a booking
• Fixed taster date: the last Saturday afternoon of every month, announced 3 weeks ahead. Don't wait for "enough people".
• Taster credit: if they sign up for the monthly class within 7 days, the ARS 40,000 counts toward it. Send this offer by WhatsApp the evening of the taster.
• Wednesday launch: take "founding member" sign-ups with a deposit and start once 4 have paid. Target is the first Wednesday of November (4 Nov). If you're not there by 28 Oct, keep the list and launch in March.
• Gift card "Regalá el torno" (taster) at the fair and on IG in Nov–Dec. Gift buyers bring you new students.
column3:
[AFTER] Turn students into your sales team
• Bring a friend: the friend's taster costs half, and when the friend finishes their first month, you get a free mug. Most of your students already come this way, so we're just making it official.
• Ask every student after month 1 for a Google review. Ask them in person, then send the link by WhatsApp.
• Repost student pieces on IG and tag them. They share it, and their friends see it.
• Send ex-students a short note every 3 months: "Your seat is waiting."
